bodies/ceres.note: Grey and cratered, with the bright spots in one crater

bodies/deimos.note: Irregular and smoother than Phobos, with a few shallow craters

bodies/earth.note: Summer state: a small Arctic ice cap and Greenland in white, fading softly into the land. The north pole is shifted toward the top of the image by the axial tilt. Keep the sprite pointing the same way in space as the planet orbits; do not turn it with the orbit

bodies/earth_snow.note: Winter overlay for earth: snow on the northern continents and a larger ice cap. Draw it over earth at the same position, scale and rotation, with the same lighting, and fade its opacity from 0 in northern summer to 1 in northern winter

bodies/jupiter.note: Seen from above the north pole, so the cloud belts are rings around a blue-grey polar region. The Great Red Spot is in the southern half and is not visible from here

bodies/mars.note: North polar ice cap in white with a darker collar around it. The north pole is shifted toward the top of the image by the axial tilt. Keep the sprite pointing the same way in space as the planet orbits; do not turn it with the orbit

bodies/mercury.note: Grey-brown and cratered, with one large pale basin and one rayed crater

bodies/moon.note: Grey with dark maria, craters and one rayed crater

bodies/moons/ariel.note: Pale grey with a network of wide canyons

bodies/moons/callisto.note: Dark and saturated with small bright craters, with one large ringed basin

bodies/moons/dione.note: Grey ice with bright wispy streaks across one side

bodies/moons/enceladus.note: Bright white ice with a few craters and blue fractures

bodies/moons/europa.note: Off-white ice crossed by reddish-brown cracks

bodies/moons/ganymede.note: Grey-brown with dark old regions, paler grooved bands and a bright rayed crater

bodies/moons/iapetus.note: Two-toned: one half dark brown, the other bright, with a ridge line along the equator

bodies/moons/io.note: Sulphur yellow with orange and white patches, dark volcanic vents and one red ring

bodies/moons/mimas.note: Grey and cratered with one very large crater that has a central peak

bodies/moons/miranda.note: Grey patchwork of ridged regions with a bright chevron

bodies/moons/oberon.note: Grey with a reddish tint and several craters with dark floors

bodies/moons/rhea.note: Grey and heavily cratered, with one small bright rayed crater

bodies/moons/tethys.note: Pale grey ice with one broad shallow crater and a long canyon

bodies/moons/titan.note: Hazy orange with soft rings of haze and a darker hood over the pole

bodies/moons/titania.note: Grey-beige with two long canyons and scattered craters

bodies/moons/triton.note: Half pinkish ice cap with dark wind streaks, half blue-green dimpled terrain

bodies/moons/umbriel.note: Dark grey and cratered, with one bright ring near the edge

bodies/neptune.note: Deep blue with faint belts, white cloud streaks and one dark spot. The north pole is shifted toward the top of the image by the axial tilt. Keep the sprite pointing the same way in space as the planet orbits; do not turn it with the orbit

bodies/phobos.note: Irregular, with the large Stickney crater at one end and grooves running from it

bodies/saturn.note: Pale gold belts and the dark hexagon at the north pole. The rings are a separate sprite, saturn_rings. The north pole is shifted toward the top of the image by the axial tilt. Keep the sprite pointing the same way in space as the planet orbits; do not turn it with the orbit

bodies/saturn_rings.note: Draw at the same position and scale as saturn, unlit. The rings clear the disc, so draw order does not matter. Ring tilt is toward the top of the image, like the planet

bodies/sun.note: Draw unlit. The disc is 96 units in radius (192 px); the rest of the image is the corona glow

bodies/uranus.note: Pale cyan. The planet lies on its side, so the pole is at the top edge with a paler cap around it. The rings are a separate sprite, uranus_rings

bodies/uranus_rings.note: Draw over uranus at the same position and scale, unlit. The part of the rings behind the planet is already cut away

bodies/venus.note: Cream cloud deck with a sideways V of darker and paler streaks

comets/coma.note: Soft glow around the nucleus; scale with sun distance

comets/tail_dust_large.note: Tail at full size, pointing left (away from a sun on the right). Pivot is the nucleus. Scale and fade it with sun distance

comets/tail_dust_medium.note: Tail at full size, pointing left (away from a sun on the right). Pivot is the nucleus. Scale and fade it with sun distance

effects/dust_sheet.note: Dust sheet blown along the ground from the impact point (pivot). Drawn for ground on the left, sheet running up; mirror for the other direction

effects/flame_atmosphere.note: Pivot is the centre of the engine bell exit; flame points left. Bell half-width is 22 units: scale the sprite to the engine. Atmosphere flame: also scale.x 1.5 low down

effects/flame_vacuum.note: Pivot is the centre of the engine bell exit; flame points left. Bell half-width is 22 units: scale the sprite to the engine. Atmosphere flame: also scale.x 1.5 low down

effects/flame_white.note: Pivot is the centre of the engine bell exit; flame points left. Bell half-width is 22 units: scale the sprite to the engine. Atmosphere flame: also scale.x 1.5 low down

effects/fragments/fragment_flame.note: Draw over a fragment, pivot on the fragment centre, pointing left (downstream). Sized for a fragment about 8 units across

effects/glow_white.note: Soft white glow for flashes, sparks and engine glow; tint with modulate

effects/plasma_blunt.note: Shock front, hot gas and streaks as one image, travel direction to the right. Pivot is the tip of the shock front

effects/plasma_pointed.note: Shock front, hot gas and streaks as one image, travel direction to the right. Pivot is the tip of the shock front

effects/plasma_wide.note: Shock front, hot gas and streaks as one image, travel direction to the right. Pivot is the tip of the shock front

effects/puff_white.note: Soft white puff for dust, smoke and tyre smoke; tint with modulate, scale up and fade out

effects/ripple_ring.note: Scale up and fade. Draw the upper half behind the craft and the lower half in front

effects/splash_spray.note: Pivot at the waterline under the craft

parachutes/cluster_torn.note: With lines. Pivot is where the lines meet; the canopy trails to the right. Sway = small rotation about the pivot; breathing = small scale.y change; packed or limp = scale.y near 0.15 to 0.3

parachutes/main_medium.note: Main parachute sized for the lander landing scenes

parachutes/main_torn.note: With lines. Pivot is where the lines meet; the canopy trails to the right. Sway = small rotation about the pivot; breathing = small scale.y change; packed or limp = scale.y near 0.15 to 0.3

parachutes/ssto_drogue.note: Runway drogue with lines; pivot where the lines meet. Attach at the tail base

parachutes/streamer.note: With lines. Pivot is where the lines meet; the canopy trails to the right. Sway = small rotation about the pivot; breathing = small scale.y change; packed or limp = scale.y near 0.15 to 0.3

ships/bullet.note: Sphere or bullet ship seen from above, nose right

ships/habitat_parts/habitat_aft.note: Draw first: engine, tanks and aft axis

ships/habitat_parts/habitat_fore.note: Draw after ring 2: forward axis, nose module and window

ships/habitat_parts/habitat_mid.note: Draw after ring 1: axis between the rings

ships/habitat_parts/habitat_ring_body.note: Ring body, same for both rings. Place pivot at the ring centre: ring 1 is 20 units aft of the ship pivot, ring 2 is 44 units forward

ships/habitat_parts/habitat_ring_face.note: Rotating ring face, drawn face-on. In the game draw it with scale.x = 0.22 at the ring centre and rotate it; the two rings turn in opposite directions

ships/lander_parts/lander_body.note: Lander without legs (for stowed gear, splashdown and aerobraking)

ships/lander_parts/lander_leg.note: One leg, deployed position, pivot on the hinge. Hinge sits 32 units aft and 50 units to the side of the lander pivot. Mirror it (scale.y = -1) for the other side. Stowed = rotated 185 degrees, drawn under the body

ships/launch_stack.note: Classic launch stack seen from above, nose right

ships/lifting_body.note: Lifting body craft seen from above, nose right

ships/linear_truss.note: Linear truss ship seen from above, nose right

ships/rotating_habitat.note: Rotating habitat seen from above, nose right, with two rings turning in opposite directions

ships/ssto_side/gear_main.note: Main gear, down position, pivot on the hinge. Stowed = rotated 90 degrees (swung aft), drawn under the hull

ships/ssto_side/ssto_side.note: Side view, nose right, gear up. Gear hinges: main 68 units aft and 12 below the pivot, nose 65 units forward and 12 below

ships/tanker.note: Propellant tanker seen from above, nose right
